[NDBG.4.2] `ds_engine_rete_match_trace(engine, fact_id, cb, user)` traces a fact
through the alpha nodes that participate in its schema dispatch, reporting per
node a `result`, the string `passed` or `filtered`, and a human-readable
detail — the "why did/didn't this fact match?" tool. A node is named by its `id`
as [NDBG.4.1] gives it, and the detail is in DS-level names ([RARC.5.3.2]).
